findings.failure_scenario: If `HFInferenceTask._prepare_mapping_info(None)` started returning the wrong `provider_id` (e.g., the mapping lookup broke or `_fetch_recommended_models` returned stale data), `HFInferenceTask("feature-extraction")._prepare_mapping_info(None).provider_id == "facebook/bart-base"` evaluates and discards the result — the test suite stays green and the regression ships.
findings.summary: The two renamed recommendation checks are bare expressions with no `assert`, so `test_hf_inference_get_recommended_model_has_recommendation` can never fail and provides no coverage of `_prepare_mapping_info`.

findings.failure_scenario: `helper._prepare_payload_as_dict("https://example.com/audio.mp3", {}, "username/repo_name")` (lines 283/286, plus 323, 335, and 197/206 for Black Forest Labs) binds `provider_mapping_info` to a `str`. The tests only pass because those payload bodies ignore the argument; the moment any of these implementations follows the new pattern and reads `provider_mapping_info.provider_id` (as `FalAITextToImageTask` does), these tests crash with `AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute ...`, and until then they silently no longer test the interface the production code actually uses.
findings.summary: Five call sites of `_prepare_payload_as_dict` were not updated after the third parameter changed from `mapped_model: str` to `provider_mapping_info: InferenceProviderMapping` and still pass a plain string positionally, so the tests now exercise an invalid call shape and validate nothing about the new parameter.

findings.failure_scenario: The diff's only adapter-related test ("Test with loras" in `test_prepare_mapping_info`) exercises just the `_prepare_mapping_info` field plumbing through a `mocker.Mock`; `FalAITextToImageTask._prepare_payload_as_dict` is only tested with `adapter_weights_path=None`. A wrong key (`loras` vs `lora_weights`), wrong `repo_id` (`hf_model_id` vs `provider_id`), or a broken `model_name` condition for `fal-ai/lora` ships with no failing test.
findings.summary: The only new production behavior introduced by this change — the fal-ai LoRA payload construction (`payload["loras"]` with the HUGGINGFACE_CO_URL_TEMPLATE URL and the `fal-ai/lora` `model_name` hack) — has no test coverage.

findings.failure_scenario: A developer adding a hardcoded mapping for local testing copies the example `InferenceProviderMapping(hf_model_id="Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct", provider_id="Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct", task="conversational", status="live")`; on the first request for that model, `kwargs.pop("providerId")` raises `KeyError: 'providerId'` (and `provider_id` silently lands as an extra attribute via `self.__dict__.update`), so the documented workflow fails immediately.
findings.summary: The documented usage example for `HARDCODED_MODEL_INFERENCE_MAPPING` constructs `InferenceProviderMapping` with `provider_id=`, but the class `__init__` only pops the camelCase key `providerId`, so copying the example raises `KeyError`.
